audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage text leaned on a Null Sphere silence that does not exist, so the level 6 flip was explained by the wrong mechanic.
audit.why: Riot's text for Null Sphere is damage, a channel interrupt and a magic-absorbing shield. There is no silence. The real level 6 flip is Riftwalk's 5/3.5/2s cooldown plus the channel interrupt on Comeuppance.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1], whys[4], mid, late and wants.foe[1] around the channel interrupt and Riftwalk's cooldown. Stage sides and ratings unchanged - Akshan levels 1-6, skill at two items, matching the mirror page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text gave no cooldown numbers for the abilities that define each spike.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s, Null Sphere 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Comeuppance 100/85/70s. Those numbers make 'wait before you step' actionable.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to spikes[1].text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Null Sphere interrupts channels, so it cancels Comeuppance mid-fire; and Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure hit, so Kassadin standing behind his wave eats none of it.
audit.why: Both are stated in Riot's own ability text and both change what you do. The mirror page already tells Kassadin to keep a minion in the line, so your side must say clear the line first.
audit.corrected: Added to report[5].t, dosFull[2], dontsFull[2].d, spikes[2].text and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns was boilerplate with no numbers.
audit.why: Null Sphere at 9s rank 1 is the punishable cooldown here - it is his only answer to your R channel.

edits.before: Riftwalk (R) flips the lane: he blinks onto you and his Q (Null Sphere) silences you for ~2.5s, cutting off your E (Heroic Swing) escape and your R channel — bank E over terrain BEFORE he closes or you get pinned.
edits.after: Riftwalk (R) flips the lane, but it is a 5s cooldown at rank 1 falling to 2s, so you track his mana bar, not a timer. Null Sphere does not silence - it interrupts channels, which means it cancels Comeuppance mid-fire on a 9s cooldown.

edits.after: Riftwalk flips the lane on a 5s cooldown, and Null Sphere interrupts channels - it cancels Comeuppance mid-fire.

edits.after: Hit 6 and blink in with Riftwalk, saving Null Sphere's 9s channel interrupt to cancel his Comeuppance

edits.before: Your Youmuu's lethality spike is your last real kill window — if he mispositions, E-in, Q, and fire R (Comeuppance), which executes harder the lower he is. Note his Void Stone passive only soaks the magic from your third-shot proc, not your physical R.
edits.after: Your Youmuu's lethality spike is your last real kill window - if he mispositions, E-in, Q, and fire R (Comeuppance), which executes harder the lower he is. Clear the line first: R stops on the first champion, minion or structure, so his own wave eats it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your last clean trading window, but Kassadin is already counting the seconds to 6, so don't expect a Nasus-style lane stomp — he's a slippery target who just needs to survive. The moment he ults, respect it: Riftwalk lets him blink onto you, and his Q (Null Sphere) silence shuts off your E (Heroic Swing) escape and your R channel for ~2.5s. Pre-bank E over terrain before he commits. From 6 onward you stop being the aggressor.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your last clean trading window, but Kassadin is already counting the seconds to 6, so don't expect a Nasus-style lane stomp - he's a slippery target who just needs to survive. The moment he ults, respect it: Riftwalk is a 5s blink at rank 1 and drops to 2s. Null Sphere is the real threat to your ultimate - it interrupts channels, cancelling Comeuppance on a 9s cooldown, so fire R only once it is spent. From 6 onward you stop being the aggressor.

edits.before: This is where you lose. Kassadin is a hard scaler and after 2+ items his stacked Riftwalk lets him blink in and out faster than your cooldowns reset, while his Q silence pins your Heroic Swing and interrupts your R (Comeuppance) mid-channel. Don't over-rely on your kit's magic side — only your third-shot passive proc is magic, and that's the one thing his Void Stone passive softens; your real burst is physical, but it doesn't matter when he blinks away or silences you before R fires. Your only path was the early-to-mid lead — if you didn't snowball it into towers and a closed game before he came online, accept you can't 1v1 him and play for objectives with your team.
edits.after: This is where you lose. Kassadin is a hard scaler and after 2+ items his stacked Riftwalk lets him blink in and out faster than your cooldowns reset - 2s at rank 3 - while Null Sphere's channel interrupt cancels R (Comeuppance) whenever he saves it. Don't over-rely on your kit's magic side - only your third-shot passive proc is magic, and that's the one thing his Void Stone passive softens; your real burst is physical, but it doesn't matter when he blinks away or eats the channel. Your only path was the early-to-mid lead - if you didn't snowball it into towers and a closed game before he came online, accept you can't 1v1 him and play for objectives with your team.

edits.after: Null Sphere interrupts channels on a 9s cooldown - it is the one button that cancels Comeuppance. Fire R once it is spent.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. It governs your forward steps. - E swing spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Null Sphere: 9s at rank 1 and it interrupts channels - the one cooldown that beats your R, so step up after he throws it. - Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s, so mana is his real limit. - Force Pulse: 21s at rank 1 and it needs spell charges.

edits.before: - Akshan vs Kassadin - Track: Kassadin Riftwalk. - Three hits and out — never flat trades. - Riftwalk down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
edits.after: - Akshan vs Kassadin - Track: Null Sphere, 9s, it interrupts your R. - Three hits and out - never flat trades. - Riftwalk is 5s; watch his mana. - Clear the R line.
